description: Fork of exp314 (DominanceCanonicalize + SDPA, DominanceToVector). Out_proj: input_nap=10 (table_dim=1024), output_nap=32, tph=256 (8.4M weights, 4x smaller than exp314's 33.6M). Adds FFN BitPermLUT after out_proj: takes concat(out_proj_input=H*d_v=64, out_proj_output=E=32)=96 -> E=32, input_nap=10 (table_dim=1024), output_nap=32, tph=512 (16.8M weights). Per-layer bit weights ~25.2M. out_to_vec is Borda-only; LN applied explicitly on the 96-dim concat before FFN. Explicit concat-skip replaces residual; gives FFN both pre- and post-out_proj views.
